programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of the 2013 floods in Uttarakhand, Kedarnath is an interfaith love story between Mandakini, a wealthy Hindu pilgrim, and Mansoor, a humble Muslim porter who carries her during her journey to the Kedarnath temple.
